doc.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024

title: Music directors and critics need knowledge
summary: He argues music directors and critics must be knowledgeable enough to judge what is played.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: And we have one of those. And I think that — but I don’t know that everybody does. But then again I don’t know that they don’t. I don’t want to sound like I’m saying other stations don’t do the same thing, but it’s just, to me it’s important that you do that. That’s always been the question, as you well know, with jazz critics, you know who is this person to critique the album? Do they have musical knowledge or do they have knowledge of whatever enough to be able to — because in the old days you know a bad review could destroy something.
